"""Owned real HTTP -> existing plugin -> existing OneBot channel -> fake gateway.

Only the final QQ gateway is simulated; no provider/transport double, real QQ,
deployment config, protected ports, or profile data are used.
"""
import asyncio
import socket
import sqlite3
import threading
import time
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor

import pytest

from packages.actions.qq_channel_provider import QQChannelProvider, QQProviderConfig


KEY = {"runId": "run_fixture", "stepId": "step_fixture", "targetId": "123456", "operationOrdinal": 0}


@pytest.fixture
def plugin_http(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    import nonebot
    import uvicorn
    try:
        driver = nonebot.get_driver()
    except ValueError:
        nonebot.init(driver="~fastapi")
        driver = nonebot.get_driver()
    from packages.qq import plugin
    from packages.qq import channels
    from packages.qq.channels.base import ChannelConfig
    from packages.qq.channels.onebot import OneBotChannel

    calls = []
    control = {"mode": "ok", "entered": threading.Event()}

    class Gateway:
        self_id = "999999"

        async def call_api(self, api, **kwargs):
            calls.append((api, kwargs))
            if control["mode"] == "send_failed":
                raise RuntimeError("gateway may have sent before losing acknowledgement")
            return {"message_id": 654321}

    channel = OneBotChannel(ChannelConfig(name="onebot", bot_uin="999999"), bot_fallback=lambda: Gateway())
    monkeypatch.setattr(channels, "_ACTIVE", channel)
    monkeypatch.setattr(channels, "_ACTIVE_CHANNELS", {"onebot": channel})
    monkeypatch.setattr(plugin, "_HISTORY_DIR", tmp_path / "history")
    app = driver.server_app

    async def wrapped(scope, receive, send):
        # Inject loss AFTER the real production handler and history write.
        async def response_send(message):
            if message["type"] == "http.response.start":
                control["entered"].set()
                if control["mode"] == "lost_ack":
                    await asyncio.sleep(0.3)
            await send(message)
        await app(scope, receive, response_send)

    listener = socket.socket()
    listener.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
    listener.listen(128)
    port = listener.getsockname()[1]
    server = uvicorn.Server(uvicorn.Config(wrapped, lifespan="off", log_level="critical"))
    thread = threading.Thread(target=server.run, kwargs={"sockets": [listener]}, daemon=True)
    thread.start()
    deadline = time.monotonic() + 5
    while not server.started and thread.is_alive() and time.monotonic() < deadline:
        time.sleep(0.01)
    assert server.started
    config = QQProviderConfig(f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}", ("999999", "888888"), "999999")
    yield config, calls, control, channel
    server.should_exit = True
    thread.join(5)
    listener.close()
    assert not thread.is_alive()


def run(provider, **kwargs):
    return asyncio.run(provider.send("user", "123456", "isolated text", effect_key=KEY, **kwargs))


def test_production_chain_durable_ack_and_exact_wire(plugin_http, tmp_path):
    config, calls, _, _ = plugin_http
    path = tmp_path / "ledger.sqlite"
    provider = QQChannelProvider(config, path)
    result = run(provider)
    assert result == {"status": "succeeded", "code": "plugin_ack", "messageId": "654321", "retryAllowed": False}
    assert calls == [("send_private_msg", {"user_id": 123456, "message": "isolated text"})]
    assert run(QQChannelProvider(config, path)) == result
    assert provider.query(KEY) == result
    assert len(calls) == 1


@pytest.mark.parametrize("mode,bot,expected", [("ok", "888888", "unknown_bot_uin"), ("disconnected", None, "bot_not_connected")])
def test_proven_plugin_rejection_explicit_retry_same_key(plugin_http, tmp_path, mode, bot, expected, monkeypatch):
    config, calls, _, channel = plugin_http
    if mode == "disconnected":
        monkeypatch.setattr(channel, "_bot_fallback", None)
    provider = QQChannelProvider(config, tmp_path / "ledger.sqlite")
    result = run(provider, bot_uin=bot)
    assert result == {"status": "rejected", "code": expected, "retryAllowed": True, "noSendProven": True}
    assert calls == []
    assert run(provider, bot_uin=bot) == result  # no automatic retry
    if mode == "disconnected":
        from packages.qq.channels.base import ChannelNotConnected
        # Replace only the gateway seam; provider and channel implementation remain real.
        class Reconnected:
            async def call_api(self, api, **kwargs):
                calls.append((api, kwargs))
                return {"message_id": 111111}
        monkeypatch.setattr(channel, "_bot_fallback", lambda: Reconnected())
    retry = asyncio.run(provider.retry_rejected("user", "123456", "isolated text", bot_uin=bot, effect_key=KEY))
    assert retry["status"] == ("succeeded" if mode == "disconnected" else "rejected")
    with sqlite3.connect(provider.ledger_path) as db:
        assert db.execute("SELECT attempts FROM qq_effects").fetchone() == (2,)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("mode", ["send_failed", "lost_ack"])
def test_ambiguous_plugin_failure_never_replayed_or_retryable(plugin_http, tmp_path, mode):
    config, calls, control, _ = plugin_http
    control["mode"] = mode
    path = tmp_path / "ledger.sqlite"
    provider = QQChannelProvider(config, path, timeout=0.08)
    receipt = run(provider)
    assert receipt["status"] == "unknown" and receipt["retryAllowed"] is False
    assert len(calls) == 1
    recovered = QQChannelProvider(config, path)
    assert recovered.query(KEY) == receipt
    assert run(recovered) == receipt
    assert asyncio.run(recovered.retry_rejected("user", "123456", "isolated text", effect_key=KEY)) == receipt
    assert len(calls) == 1


def test_concurrent_hosts_claim_before_http_and_recovery(plugin_http, tmp_path):
    config, calls, control, _ = plugin_http
    control["mode"] = "lost_ack"
    path = tmp_path / "ledger.sqlite"
    one, two = QQChannelProvider(config, path), QQChannelProvider(config, path)
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(2) as pool:
        future = pool.submit(run, one)
        assert control["entered"].wait(3)
        intent = two.query(KEY)
        assert intent["code"] == "intent_persisted" and intent["status"] == "unknown"
        assert run(two) == intent
        assert future.result()["status"] == "succeeded"
    assert len(calls) == 1


def test_identity_binding_and_trusted_bot_selection(plugin_http, tmp_path):
    config, calls, _, _ = plugin_http
    provider = QQChannelProvider(config, tmp_path / "ledger.sqlite")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="trusted configuration"):
        run(provider, bot_uin="777777")
    assert calls == []
    run(provider)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="already bound"):
        asyncio.run(provider.send("user", "123456", "changed", effect_key=KEY))
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="already bound"):
        run(provider, bot_uin="888888")
    assert len(calls) == 1


@pytest.mark.parametrize("args", [("private", "123456", "text"), ("user", "https://invalid", "text"), ("user", "123456", "")])
def test_strict_job_inputs_before_transport(tmp_path, args):
    provider = QQChannelProvider(QQProviderConfig("http://127.0.0.1:1", ("999999",), "999999"), tmp_path / "ledger.sqlite")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        asyncio.run(provider.send(*args, effect_key=KEY))
    assert provider.query(KEY)["code"] == "no_local_receipt"


def test_trusted_config_selection_matches_plugin_precedence():
    cfg = {"qq": {"plugin_id": "snowluma", "channel": "snowluma",
                  "snowluma": {"accounts": [{"bot_uin": "999999"}, {"bot_uin": "888888"}]},
                  "channels": [{"name": "napcat", "bot_uin": "777777"}]}}
    selected = QQProviderConfig.from_host_config(cfg, endpoint="http://127.0.0.1:8080")
    assert selected.bot_uins == ("999999", "888888") and selected.default_bot_uin == "999999"
    del cfg["qq"]["plugin_id"]
    assert QQProviderConfig.from_host_config(cfg, endpoint="http://127.0.0.1:8080").bot_uins == ("777777",)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        QQProviderConfig.from_host_config({"qq": {}}, endpoint="http://127.0.0.1:8080")


def test_pre_send_crash_intent_never_retried(plugin_http, tmp_path):
    config, calls, _, _ = plugin_http
    path = tmp_path / "ledger.sqlite"
    provider = QQChannelProvider(config, path)
    # A process can die after intent commit and before network I/O. Conservatively
    # retain the same unknown state; absence of a gateway call is not durable proof.
    from packages.actions.qq_channel_provider import _digest, _json
    body = {"target_type": "private", "target_id": "123456", "text": "isolated text", "bot_uin": "999999"}
    receipt = provider._receipt("unknown", "intent_persisted", remoteQuerySupported=False)
    with sqlite3.connect(path) as db:
        db.execute("INSERT INTO qq_effects VALUES (?, ?, ?, 1)", (_json(KEY), _digest({"endpoint": config.endpoint, "body": body}), _json(receipt)))
    assert run(QQChannelProvider(config, path)) == receipt
    assert calls == []
